title: Rights and permission record
description: Whether and how a source may be quoted, reproduced or redistributed, and the trail of any permission request. Embedded as the 'rights' field of a source record. Basis notes are the project's analysis, not legal advice.

status.description: The build refuses quotations beyond a short passage unless status is no-permission-needed or granted.

basis.description: Why use is allowed (or that the source is linked only).

basis_note.description: One or two sentences explaining the basis.

license.description: SPDX identifier or name of the source's own license, if any.

redistribution.description: True only when the project may serve a copy of the file itself.

log.description: Dated steps in the permission process. Name roles or offices, not private contact details.

with.description: Role or office contacted, e.g. 'Tribal Court Administrator'.

evidence_private.description: True when a copy of the correspondence is kept privately outside the repository.
